Innovative Academics

With 79 majors and 87 minors, UNLV does more than offer options — we provide opportunities. Plus, if your professional ambitions require you to obtain multiple degrees, UNLV also has more than 199 graduate degree and certificate programs and our own law, medicine, and dental medicine schools. We are proud that our academics draw upon the influences of our community, and offer an education like nowhere else.

All degree programs 

From the President

"UNLV is proud to celebrate International Education Week (IEW) in November! Events across campus will encourage international education and exchange, highlighting the amazing global community at UNLV and in Las Vegas. Explore new cultures and perspectives at these upcoming events. Everyone is welcome!"

View events 

A Worldwide Destination

Dripping in the golden desert sun and spread across 335 acres in the heart of Las Vegas, UNLV provides nowhere-else opportunities in this 24-hour metropolis. And while Las Vegas might be the center of it all, it doesn't take long to slip the bonds of this little oasis and get out into the desert, as we are just minutes from natural getaways and less than a day's drive from the entire American Southwest.

  • Our Campus 
  • Las Vegas 

Hieu Nguyen Quote

"Being a Rebel means I can make whatever I wish to achieve happen. I have no doubts. Just sit back and watch me become exceptional just like my peers."
Camille McDuff-Jones - Major: Electrical Engineering
  • We Are Rebels 

Campus Life

At UNLV, you aren't just part of a university, you're part of an inclusive campus community where everyone can find their place. Students have access to state-of-the-art facilities, a modern recreation center, and many choices for dining and housing. With hundreds of organizations, clubs, sports, and events, there's always a way to get involved and make lifelong friendships and connections.

Campus Life
